hook: a stranded fellow courier with a bent route pin

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A broad simiah courier grins through road dust, wrapped in a battered coat, tapping a cracked compass while coin charms and route tags hang from the straps.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Road-worn and warm, humming when he feels safe and silent when he does not. Taps a cracked compass that points to the last place he felt safe instead of north, and pretends that is a feature.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A way forward A grounded question A scene-specific clue seed
